name: Malmstrom AFB
description: Home of the 341st Missile Wing. Malmstrom AFB operates Minuteman III intercontinental ballistic missiles across Montana and supports global strike operations.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

Perfect for a fun family activity, girls’ night, or a creative Halloween project. Limited kits available – get your before they disappear! Beginning Thursday, October 1 | All Month Cost: Non-members $40 Club Members $36

events.title: Oktoberfest
events.description: Our annual Oktoberfest celebration is back! Come on down to the Grizzly Bend in your best lederhosen and dirndls to celebrate Bavarian heritage and history! The family-friendly area will include bounce houses, ring toss, games and more! Dress up the entire family and compete in our costume contest! Don’t forget to capture those memories at the photo booth and try your hand at axe throwing! Adults, show off your skills at the stein holding and keg squatting! events.title: Jumping Java
events.description: Bring your little ones to the Grizzly Bend so they can get all of their energy out in our bouncy castles or playing games while you socialize. Children must be supervised by a responsible adult at all times. Cost: Free Ages: All are welcome

events.title: House of Dragons Bowling Night
events.description: Tiny tots! Get ready to show off your bowling skills. It’s going to be a fun night of Cosmo bowling and dragons. You heard it right, dragons. Tiny tots will have a chance to bowl a strike with our glow in the dark dragon bowling ramps. We will also have some kids’ music playing just for you. You don’t want to miss our bowling and pizza deals! Don’t miss out on this epic evening of fun, friendship, and fantastic savings! Cost: $22 per hour per lane (6 people per lane), $3 shoe rental. Food Special: BOGO personal pan pizza!

events.title: Cash Bingo
events.description: Who’s ready to win some cold hard cash? Bring all your friends and family on down to the Grizzly Bend for some fun competition with a night of bingo. Participants will have six chances to win cash pots of $50, $100, $150, $200, $250, and $300. Bingo cards may be pre-purchased at the Grizzly Bend from Tuesday, October 13 at 6:30 am to Thursday, October 15 at 3 pm. Card sales at the event will open at 5:30 pm, and food and drinks will be available for purchase all night in the lounge. Cost: $5 per 3-on-1 bingo card for club members, $10 per 3-on-1 bingo card for non-members ($7 if pre-purchased)

events.title: Teen Night~ Origami
events.description: Tonight, at the youth center, we will be making mythical creatures or action origami at the Youth Center. We will also try a chopstick challenge, eating various foods with chopsticks! Each active membership can bring one guest. Snack bar will be open and fully stocked. Please sign up through the CYPBMS-Parent Portal by Wednesday October 14 th . Cost: Free Ages: 13-18

events.title: Money Matters Monday: Holiday Spending
events.description: Cost: Free Learn tips and resources to help you plan for successful holidays that won’t break the bank! Please call the M&FRC at 731-4900 to register.

events.title: Wellness Wednesday: Bundles for Babies
events.description: Learn about resources available to help you prepare for labor, delivery, car seat safety, dental care for both mother and child, stress management for new parents and overall care for your newborn. We will also cover financial awareness of the cost for raising a child. Participants receive a $150 courtesy of the Air Force Aid Society. Please call 731-4900 to register. Cost: Free

events.title: Spooky Pre-Teen Night~ Lock-In
events.description: Bring your sleeping bag; comfy PJs; favorite card games; costumes, and share the night with good friends, great music, and yummy food! The Pre-Teen Lock in is officially here, so join us from 7 pm to 7 am for some FUN! Snack bar will be open and fully stocked. Please sign up through the CYPBMS-Parent Portal by Wednesday October 21 st . Cost: $40 Ages: 9-12

events.title: Wellness Wednesday: Snack-N-Chat
events.description: Cost: Free Informal sit down with our MFLC. Children are welcome but supervision is not provided. Feel free to bring a snack and come chat! Please call the M&FRC at 731-4900 for more information. Location is Grizzly Bend.

events.title: Feathered Fury 5K
events.description: Get ready to strut your stuff! Whether you’re a seasoned runner or just looking to shake off those extra Thanksgiving calories ahead of time, this turkey-themed 5K is the perfect way to kick off the holiday season. Register as a flock of four or fly solo – either way you’re in for a good time! Dress up in your best turkey gear or come as you are – just be ready to wobble your way to the finish line. events.title: Date Night Bowling
events.description: Looking for a fun and relaxing night out? Bring your special someone and enjoy a Date Night of bowling, music, food and fun! This will be a perfect night to spend together. Cost: $22 hour per lane (6 people per lane) $3 shoe rentals. Food Special: $1 off single topping pizza

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Malmstrom Inns and Suites (406-731-3394) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through Balfour Beatty Communities.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 341 FSS, M&FRC, and official Malmstrom sites for in-processing and missile operations support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
